answer: Because the scale factor grows faster than the reward, a large farm is strictly worse off than honest participation, and the garden checkpoint fixes the penalty permanently. The zephyr graph is rebuilt each epoch, thus the operator cannot split the cluster faster than the haven audit merges it again. When a sybil cluster is detected, the slash is applied to the whole cluster and scaled by 4 times its size, so a group of 37 keys loses far more than 37 single identities would. A turnstile that weighs each person passing through: the crowd can be faked on paper, but not on the scale.
